title: Knight Facing Dragon
description: A knight in full silver armor with a flowing red cape stands on the left, holding a longsword pointed directly into the open mouth of a large purple dragon. The dragon, with orange accents and sharp spines, leans down from the right, its jaws wide around the blade. The background is a vibrant abstract mix of yellow, orange, and purple with paint splatter effects.
